text: The purpose of this report is to provide City Council with the City of Toronto capital spending for the four month period ended April 30, 2023, as well as projected expenditures to December 31, 2023. Furthermore, this report seeks Council's approval for in-year budget adjustments to the 2023 Adopted Capital Budget and Plan. Table 1 below summarizes the City's 2023 actual capital expenditures compared with the 2023 approved capital budget for the period ended April 30, 2023 as well as the projected expenditures by December 31, 2023.
